meta.title: Tajo Pages | Comics born in Toledo
meta.description: Tajo Pages is a comic book brand born in Toledo. Incredible adventures, told page by page.

contacto.texto: One single contact email address for everything: collaboration proposals, press and any question about Tajo Pages. It is answered from there.

comics.texto: This is where Tajo Pages comics will appear, each one with its cover, its synopsis and where to read it. None is published yet: Tajo Pages has only just started.
comics.portada: Cover of TOLETUM No. 1: Celestial Invader

p1.texto: Tajo Pages is a comic book brand born in Toledo, with stories made to be read page by page.

p2.texto: Right here, at tajo.page. This website is the home of the brand and the place where its stories will be published.

p3.texto: Tajo Pages has only just started. The first comics will appear in the Comics section as soon as they are ready.

p1.texto: The Tajo, known in English as the Tagus, surrounds Toledo on three sides and has been part of the city's image for centuries.

p2.texto: In Spanish, a tajo is also a sword cut. And Toledo has been famous for its swords for centuries.

p3.texto: Pages, because every story is told page by page. And because its home on the internet is tajo.page.

p1.texto: Anyone who draws, writes, colours or letters comics and wants to tell stories with Tajo Pages.

p2.texto: Who you are, what you do and links to work you have already published. That is enough to start talking.

p3.texto: Send an email to the address shown below, with the subject “Tajo Pages collaboration”. No forms and no middlemen.

celestial-invader.001: Toletum, 13th century. The city sleeps behind its walls.
celestial-invader.002: On the wall, old Mateo the watchman keeps his watch.
celestial-invader.004: It was no star. It was fire falling from the sky.
celestial-invader.005: A deep rumble rattles the shutters across half the city.
celestial-invader.006: At the Tajo inn, Hernán de Castilla wakes with a start.
celestial-invader.007: It is heading straight for the heart of the city!
celestial-invader.009: The blast knocks down stalls, carts and chimneys.
celestial-invader.010: Where the market stood, there is now a crater.
celestial-invader.011: While everyone flees, one man walks toward the danger.
celestial-invader.012: Captain Rodrigo and his guard surround the crater.
celestial-invader.013: “What has fallen here, Rodrigo?” “Nothing good, Hernán.”
celestial-invader.014: The stone from the sky is still burning inside.
celestial-invader.016: Inside the stone there is an egg. A huge egg.
celestial-invader.018: Friar Anselmo calls for calm; others want to smash it with their axes.
celestial-invader.019: “Let no one come near until dawn!”
celestial-invader.020: The shell is as hot as a stone baking in the sun.
celestial-invader.021: Thump... thump... thump... Something is beating inside.
celestial-invader.022: The night passes. No one watches what they should.
celestial-invader.024: SSSSS! The iron melts like wax.
